items.t: Brake booster pump failure with ABS and brake lights
items.job: Replace brake booster and brake booster pump assembly
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of about $2,500-3,450. Toyota support program 21TE01 may still cover 2012-2014 cars within 10 years/150,000 miles; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: ABS and brake lights from failing brake actuator
items.job: Replace brake booster / ABS actuator assembly
items.note: RepairPal puts a Prius v brake booster replacement at about $1,280-1,450; a full ABS actuator costs more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings, or install a used engine
items.note: Owners report typical bills around $3,000-3,300. Topping off oil between changes is the low-cost way to live with it.

items.t: Head gasket failure
items.job: Replace head gasket and clean EGR parts
items.note: One owner was quoted $3,400 for the gasket job and $5,000 for a replacement engine.

items.t: Inverter can overheat and limit power (recall)
items.job: Hybrid control software update

items.t: Hybrid system can shut down and stall (recall)
items.job: Hybrid software update; inverter repair or replacement if failed

items.t: Hybrid battery cooling fan clogged with dust
items.job: Clean hybrid battery cooling fan and filter
items.note: Cheap if caught early; a battery damaged by heat costs far more.

items.t: Car won't go into READY mode
items.job: Test and replace 12-volt battery
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $300 for a Prius c 12-volt battery. If the battery tests good, add diagnosis time.

items.t: Check engine light with code P2610
items.job: Reprogram engine control computer per bulletin

items.t: Musty or chemical smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Replace cabin filter, clear A/C drain, clean evaporator

items.t: A/C blows warm from compressor or condenser failure
items.job: Replace electric A/C compressor and recharge
items.note: One owner paid about $1,680 for parts and $540 labor. A condenser alone costs much less.

items.t: Headlight bulbs burn out often
items.job: Replace both low-beam bulbs and check connectors

items.t: Dim headlights at night
items.job: Aim headlights and restore lenses or upgrade bulbs

items.t: Brakes grab or release oddly in wet weather
items.job: Brake system inspection and code scan
items.note: Parts cost depends on what is found; see the brake booster item if codes point to it.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor out of calibration (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate occupant sensing system

items.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate occupant classification system

items.t: Windshield cracks easily
items.job: Replace windshield
items.note: Owners report about $1,500 on average. Insurance glass coverage often pays.

items.t: Tire pressure warning may not work (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate tire pressure monitoring system

items.t: Spare tire may be under-inflated from the factory (recall)
items.job: Inspect and inflate spare tire

items.t: DC-DC converter can fail and cut power (recall)
items.job: Replace DC-DC converter

items.t: Airbag warning label missing (recall)
items.job: Install airbag warning label
